lines.en: : Hi Nao. It’s really nice to see you for the first time today.
lines.zh: 嗨,Nao。今天第一次见到你,真好。

lines.en: : What are you doing over here by yourself? Is Kaori off building her time machine or whatever it is?
lines.zh: 你一个人在这边干什么?Kaori 是去造她的时光机还是随便什么去了?

lines.en: : She won a prize?
lines.zh: 她中了奖?

lines.en: : Also, did you write that yourself?
lines.zh: 还有,那是你自己写的吗?

lines.en: : Since when do you know how to write?
lines.zh: 你从什么时候起会写字了?

lines.en: : Okay. Well, I guess Kaori can work on teaching you listening comprehension whenever she gets back.
lines.zh: 好。嗯,我猜等 Kaori 回来,可以让她练练你的听力理解。

lines.en: : I’ll keep you company for now, though. The last thing I want is some dangerous man finding you out here all alone and taking advantage of you while no one else is around to watch. I mean help.
lines.zh: 不过,我暂时陪陪你。我最不想见到的,就是某个危险的男人发现你独自在这里、趁四下无人对你上下其手。我是说,趁四下无人帮你。

lines.en: : It’s nothing you need to be concerned about. Kaori says there might just be a me inside of me. And if there was a me inside of me then me would probably make me say things like that.
lines.zh: 不是你需要担心的事。Kaori 说,我的里面可能还有一个我。要是我的里面有一个我,那那个我大概会让我说出这种话。

lines.en: : Who even knows at this point? Let’s just have a normal conversation now that you’re not bound by the confines of Kaori’s premade notebooks.
lines.zh: 到这一步,谁说得清呢?既然你已经不受 Kaori 预制笔记本的限制,我们就正常聊吧。

lines.en: : I don’t mean to upset you, but that looks nothing like me.
lines.zh: 我不是想让你难过,但那画得一点也不像我。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I don’t expect you to be a master artist when you’ve only just started-
lines.zh: 没关系。我才不指望你刚一上手就当大师——

lines.en: : You really scare me sometimes.
lines.zh: 你有时候真的吓到我了。

lines.en: : I’m being serious, though. Nothing about your existence makes any sense. And given the nature of this world, I can’t rule out that you might be something that very much doesn’t belong here.
lines.zh: 不过我是认真的。你的存在毫无道理可言。鉴于这个世界的本质,我无法排除你可能是某种完全不属于这里的东西。

lines.en: : So, now that you have the ability to at least somewhat share your thoughts with me, explaining where you come from might be helpful. And it would make me like you more.
lines.zh: 所以,既然你现在多少有能力和我分享想法,解释一下你从哪来,或许有帮助。那也会让我更喜欢你。

lines.en: : Yes, you.
lines.zh: 对,就是你。

lines.en: : That’s not what I was getting at, Nao...
lines.zh: 我不是那个意思,Nao……

lines.en: : If you don’t understand, it’s fine.
lines.zh: 你要是不明白,也没关系。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to learn a little more about you so I don’t have to approach you with an air of uncertainty every time I make my way over. But if I have to wait a little longer, that’s fine too.
lines.zh: 我只是想多了解你一点,这样每次走过来时,我就不必带着一脸不确定。但如果得再等一阵,也没关系。

lines.en: : You are most certainly not a normal girl, Nao.
lines.zh: 你绝对不是个普通的女孩,Nao。

lines.en: : Hey, there’s no need to pretend-yell about it. Because, in a roundabout way, you’re actually more normal than the girl who’s raising you. And that’s both very odd and very impressive.
lines.zh: 嘿,没必要假装大喊大叫。因为绕着弯说,你其实比抚养你的那个女孩更正常。这既非常古怪,又非常了不起。

lines.en: : I guess what I’m most concerned about is just where you came from. And why you showed up just hours after Kaori received a treasure map with your sweatshirt’s kanji on it.
lines.zh: 我猜我最关心的,就是你从哪来。以及,为什么 Kaori 收到那张印着你卫衣上汉字的藏宝图之后仅仅几个小时,你就出现了。

lines.en: : I’d also like to know how you can do that with your eyes.
lines.zh: 我还想知道,你的眼睛是怎么做到那个的。

lines.en: : Listen, I have a feeling that nothing you write in that notebook is going to make me any more sure of anything. So if you want to just go back to trying to telepathically communicate, that’s fine by-
lines.zh: 听着,我有种预感:你在那个本子上写的任何东西,都不会让我对任何事更有把握。所以你要是想回到尝试心灵感应的老路上,我没意——

lines.en: : Is...is that a star?
lines.zh: 那……那是一颗星星?

lines.en: : Well, what does a star have to do with anything?
lines.zh: 嗯,一颗星星和这有什么关系?

lines.en: : Are you trying to tell me you’re going to be famous?
lines.zh: 你是想告诉我,你会出名吗?

lines.en: : I wish you the best of luck. But I do hope you know that becoming famous is probably going to require a little more vocalization.
lines.zh: 祝你好运。不过我确实希望你知道,想出名,多半需要多出一点声音。

lines.en: : That’s not what you were trying to tell me, was it?
lines.zh: 那不是你想告诉我的事,对吧?

lines.en: : Oh, you’re a famous person’s daughter.
lines.zh: 哦,你是名人的女儿。

lines.en: : Or not.
lines.zh: 或者不是。

lines.en: Nao hops off of her chair and steps closer to me, prompting Frog Boy to make a quick escape because he is smarter than all of the girls I know and can actually tell that I’m a predator.
lines.zh: Nao 从椅子上跳下来,朝我走近,吓得青蛙男孩火速逃离——因为他比我认识的所有女孩都聪明,真能看出来我是个捕食者。

lines.en: She’s sad to see him go. And I’m sad to see her sad to see him go.
lines.zh: 他走了,她很伤心。而看她为他伤心,我很伤心。

lines.en: Then she looks up at me and is sad to see me sad to see her sad to see him go.
lines.zh: 然后她抬头看我,又为「我为她的伤心而伤心」而伤心。

lines.en: She tries to comfort me with a tantalizing gaze that whispers “steal me” loud enough to overtake the fire as the loudest entity around, but I’ve already filled my pockets with other important things.
lines.zh: 她试图用一个勾人的眼神安慰我——那眼神悄声说着「偷走我」,响得盖过了火,成为周遭最大声的存在。但我的口袋里,已经塞满了其他重要的东西。

lines.en: And there is no pair of pants large enough to fit a half-grown “human being” into them unless that human being is literally just wearing the pants. But these are my pants so that’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: 而且,世上没有任何一条裤子大到能把一个半大「人类」塞进去——除非那个人类真的只是穿着那条裤子。但这是我的裤子,所以那种事不会发生。

lines.en: : Hey. You should probably leave. Things are happening inside of my head again.
lines.zh: 嘿。你大概该走了。我的脑袋里又有事情在发生了。

lines.en: No they’re not.
lines.zh: 不,没有。

lines.en: : Yes they are.
lines.zh: 有的。

lines.en: No, they’re seriously not. I ain’t doing shit, bud.
lines.zh: 不,真的没有。我什么都没干,伙计。

lines.en: : You can only lie to me so many times, you know.
lines.zh: 你能骗我的次数可是有限的,知道吗。

lines.en: : No, not you. The me inside of me.
lines.zh: 不,不是说你。是我里面的那个我。

lines.en: : The one that I denied but am currently accepting because I can’t figure out a more convenient method of explaining away why my most depraved cravings are suddenly burning brighter than the fire behind you.
lines.zh: 那个我一度否认、如今正在接受的我——因为我实在想不出更省事的办法,来解释为什么我最堕落的渴望,忽然烧得比你身后的火还亮。

lines.en: : Right. Yes. Probably. Still can’t understand what you’re thinking, but probably. Anyway, will Kaori be back soon? Because this is getting kind of-
lines.zh: 对。是。大概。我还是读不懂你在想什么,但大概。总之,Kaori 快回来了吗?因为这有点——

lines.en: : What?...
lines.zh: 什么?……

lines.en: : Is now really the best time to be asking me to pat your head?
lines.zh: 现在真的是让我摸你头的最佳时机吗?

lines.en: : You...think that will calm me down?
lines.zh: 你……觉得那样能让我平静下来?

lines.en: : Why aren’t you afraid of me?
lines.zh: 你为什么不怕我?

lines.en: : Why didn’t Frog Boy warn you that I’m someone you should stay away from? Have you given him enough words? Does he only rest on your head because it’s warm?
lines.zh: 为什么青蛙男孩没有警告你,要离我这种人远点?你给过他足够的词吗?他待在你头上,只是因为那里暖和吗?

lines.en: : Also, why do I suddenly feel like there’s a part of the day I’m not fully remembering? Because everything else seems fine. Everything else seems normal. And looking at you is making me feel-
lines.zh: 还有,为什么我突然觉得,今天有一段时光我没有完整记得?因为其他一切看起来都好。其他一切看起来都正常。而看着你,让我觉得——

lines.en: : I can’t do that, Nao. I can’t-
lines.zh: 我不能那么做,Nao。我不能——

lines.en: : Fuck!
lines.zh: 靠!

lines.en: turn on the lights something eggy is about to happen
lines.zh: 把灯打开 有蛋的事情就要发生了

lines.en: TONIGHT AT 9 ~ 3 STORIES OF THE EGG BOY
lines.zh: 今晚 9 点 ~ 蛋男孩的三个故事

lines.en: many viewers ask what is the meaning of the egg and all questions will finally be answers
lines.zh: 许多观众问蛋的意义是什么 所有问题终将得到回答

lines.en: Can boy egg find what it takes to meaning of life inside long world? And what does mean for Maya?
lines.zh: 蛋男孩能否在漫长世界中找到人生意义所需之物?这对 Maya 又意味着什么?

lines.en: all this is more coming up soon
lines.zh: 这些以及更多 即将播出

lines.en: : it 10 o clock, you know where childrens are?
lines.zh: 十点了,你知道孩子们在哪吗?

lines.en: Nao’s affection has increased by one.
lines.zh: Nao 的好感度提升了 1。

lines.en: : Aaaaaaaaand we’re back. Thanks again for joining us on this very special morning and, let me just say, boy do we have a show in store for you today.
lines.zh: 好————我们回来了。再次感谢在这个非常特别的早晨加入我们,而且让我直说,今天的节目可有的看了。

lines.en: : That’s right, Plant #2. Joining us in the studio today is the esteemed Akira Arakawa and his circus of sex monkeys.
lines.zh: 没错,2 号植物。今天做客演播室的,是尊贵的 Akira Arakawa,以及他的性爱猴马戏团。

lines.en: : Before we go any further, allow me to just say — I am so thankful for this opportunity. Becoming a part of the very entity I have based my life around has been nothing short of amazing thus far.
lines.zh: 在继续之前,容我说一句——我非常感谢这个机会。成为我赖以为生之实体的一部分,至今为止简直妙不可言。

lines.en: : Even if I fucking hate everything that’s happening now and it’s driving me insane because I’m trying to solve a 12452342432 piece puzzle and I only have like 478 pieces.
lines.zh: 即便我他妈恨透了现在发生的一切,而它快把我逼疯了,因为我正在拼一幅 12452342432 块的拼图,而手里只有大概 478 块。

lines.en: : Careful now, the people have been conditioned to think that all numbers are important and now you’re taking up unnecessary space on someone’s computer.
lines.zh: 小心点,人们已经被调教得以为所有数字都重要,而你正在某人的电脑上占用不必要的空间。

lines.en: : Tell that to his 438573 save slots LOL.
lines.zh: 把这话去跟他那 438573 个存档位说吧,哈哈。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Let’s end it there because I’m not the topic of discussion today.
lines.zh: 是是是。到这打住吧,因为今天我可不是讨论的话题。

lines.en: : You’re not the host either, BITCH. That’s my job now.
lines.zh: 你也不是主持人,贱人。那现在是我的工作。

lines.en: : Yeah, well you’re not even a real plant. You’re just a bundle of sticks in a vase.
lines.zh: 是吗,可你连真正的植物都不是。你只是一捆插在花瓶里的树枝。

lines.en: : Woooooow. Tell us how you really feel, Plant #1.
lines.zh: 哇————。说说你的真实感受吧,1 号植物。

lines.en: : Yeah. Tell us, Plant #1. I’m right here, motherfucker. Say that shit to my face.
lines.zh: 对。说吧,1 号植物。我就在这儿,混蛋。有种当着我的面说。

lines.en: : You don’t have a face, idiot. You are sticks. Sticks in a big cup. Now, go back to your seat and stop making our show look like an episode of Jerry Springer.
lines.zh: 你没有脸,白痴。你是树枝。大杯子里的树枝。现在,回你的座位去,别把我们的节目搞得像一集 Jerry Springer 秀。

lines.en: : Not cool, man. He’s dead now.
lines.zh: 不厚道啊,兄弟。他现在死了。

lines.en: : Is he really? I had no idea.
lines.zh: 真的吗?我不知道啊。

lines.en: : Ahem. Ladies and gentlemen! On today’s episode of “What’s in the Pot?” we’ll be reading mean tweets some of the viewers have written about Akira Arakawa!
lines.zh: 咳嗯。女士们先生们!在今天这期《锅里有什么》中,我们将朗读部分观众写给 Akira Arakawa 的恶毒推文!

lines.en: : That’s right, folks. With your help, we’ve received 344235426145415136 different tweets to choose from. And-
lines.zh: 没错,各位。在你们的帮助下,我们收到了 344235426145415136 条不同的推文可供挑选。而且——

lines.en: : Is it even “tweeting” anymore now that the app has been renamed to X?
lines.zh: 那应用都改名成 X 了,还能叫「发推」吗?

lines.en: : Seriously, who invited this guy?
lines.zh: 说真的,谁请这人来的?

lines.en: : ...and we’ve increased our upper cockroach limit as we needed extra help filtering out the bot comments from the real ones!
lines.zh: ……我们还上调了蟑螂上限,因为把机器人评论从真人评论里过滤出去,需要额外帮手!

lines.en: : Which brings us to comment number one! Doris62573tzy90 says “nudes in bio.” Akira, how would you like to-
lines.zh: 这就带来了第一条评论!Doris62573tzy90 说「简介里有裸照」。Akira,你想不想——

lines.en: : Bro, you’re reading from the wrong list. Those are the bot comments.
lines.zh: 兄弟,你念错名单了。那些是机器人评论。

lines.en: : They’re selling nudes of robots now?
lines.zh: 现在连机器人的裸照都有人卖了?

lines.en: : Oh my god.
lines.zh: 我的天。

lines.en: : Okay! The real first tweet is this-
lines.zh: 好!真正的第一条推文是这个——

lines.en: : “This guy’s inner monologue is seriously infuriating. He can fuck any girl he wants but instead, all he does is cry and bitch all day. Like, we get it. You’re sad. That’s not why I’m here.”
lines.zh: 「这家伙的内心独白真让人火大。他想上哪个女孩都能上,结果呢,整天除了哭就是发牢骚。我说,我们懂的。你很伤心。但我来这不是为这个。」

lines.en: : Thoughts, Plant #1? You’re a big Akira fan, right?
lines.zh: 有何感想,1 号植物?你可是 Akira 的头号粉丝,对吧?

lines.en: : I don’t want to say I’m a “fan” because someone will interpret that as me being supportive of his actions. But I think he’s a strong character, albeit one with many flaws.
lines.zh: 我不想说我是「粉丝」,因为有人会把它理解成我支持他的行为。但我觉得他是个立得住的角色,尽管毛病一堆。

lines.en: : But, without those flaws, we’d have nothing. So I think they’re kind of necessary, all things considered.
lines.zh: 但要是没有那些毛病,我们就什么都没有了。所以综合考虑,我觉得那些毛病多少是必要的。

lines.en: : Hey, what point is there to reading mean tweets if we’re just going to comment on and diminish them immediately after they’re read? Aren’t we supposed to be mocking him?
lines.zh: 嘿,要是念完恶评我们马上就去点评、去贬低它们,那读恶评还有什么意义?我们不应该是来嘲笑他的吗?

lines.en: : I think so? I’ll just find one where we can’t do that and- a-hah! Here we go.
lines.zh: 我觉得是?那我找一条我们没法那么做的——啊哈!找到了。

lines.en: : “Ew. Circumsized? Why? Lol”
lines.zh: 「咦。割过包皮?为什么?哈哈」

lines.en: : I’m just going to tell myself that one was a bot too.
lines.zh: 我就告诉自己,那条也是机器人发的。

lines.en: : We’re all in agreement that circumsized dicks are where it’s at, right?
lines.zh: 我们都同意,割过包皮的 jj 才是正道,对吧?

lines.en: : I mean, no dick is “where it’s at” in my opinion. But yeah, I prefer the ones that don’t hide in little skin caves when they’re not gettin’ nasty with school girls.
lines.zh: 嗯,在我看来,没有哪根 jj 是「正道」。不过对,我更喜欢那种,不跟女学生厮混时也不躲进小皮洞里的。

lines.en: : I agree with Plant #4. Penises don’t need a jacket. And if mutilating children is the price we have to pay for that, so be it.
lines.zh: 我同意 4 号植物。penis 不需要穿外套。而如果残割儿童是我们为此必须付出的代价,那也认了。

lines.en: : Wait, I just realized — are we even allowed to be saying stuff like this in front of Nao-chan?
lines.zh: 等等,我刚意识到——当着 Nao 酱的面,我们可以说这种话吗?

lines.en: : Holy shit. Is she here? I don’t have eyes, so I can’t check.
lines.zh: 我的天。她在吗?我没有眼睛,没法确认。

lines.en: : Yeah, I just got word from our producers that she hitched a ride with Akira when he got all eggy a minute ago.
lines.zh: 是,我刚从制作组那里得到消息,一分钟前 Akira 蛋化的时候,她搭了他的便车。

lines.en: : That’s possible?
lines.zh: 那也可能?

lines.en: : Bro, this is Lessons in Love. Anything is possible.
lines.zh: 兄弟,这可是 Lessons in Love。一切皆有可能。

lines.en: : Anything except consensual sex you mean.
lines.zh: 你是想说,除了自愿的性爱以外的一切。

lines.en: : Ayooooooo.
: Are we seriously just going to ignore all of the legally consenting MILFs during their update?
lines.zh: 我们真要无视更新里那些法定自愿的 MILF 吗?

lines.en: : Uhhhhh, when the best events in that update are the ones with my girl NAO-CHAN, hell yeah we are!
lines.zh: 呃啊啊,当那次更新里最好的事件都是我家 NAO 酱的事件时,必须无视!

lines.en: : Nao-chan! Since you’re here as well, why don’t we read some mean tweets about you next?
lines.zh: Nao 酱!既然你也在这里,接下来我们读几条关于你的恶毒推文怎么样?

lines.en: : Oh, hell no! You can’t poke fun at that little ball of moonlight while she’s right there in front of us! What if she cries?
lines.zh: 哦,想都别想!她本人就站在我们面前,你不能拿那团小月光开玩笑!她要是哭了呢?

lines.en: : The second Nao-chan cries is the second I go find a new product to fangirl over but then ultimately come back to this one because I’m in too deep at this point.
lines.zh: Nao 酱一哭,我就会立刻去找新产品狂热追星,但最终还是会回到这一款,毕竟我此刻已经陷得太深。

lines.en: : We could always read nice tweets about her instead?
lines.zh: 我们倒是可以改读关于她的友好推文?

lines.en: : Nice tweets? Do those exist?
lines.zh: 友好推文?那种东西存在吗?

lines.en: : Uhhhhh...I think I can find a few. Let’s see- oh! Here’s one.
lines.zh: 呃啊啊……我想我能找到几条。让我看看——哦!这条。

lines.en: : “I want to season Nao-chan’s meat pocket with my special sauce.”
lines.zh: 「我想用我的特制酱汁,给 Nao 酱的肉袋调味。」

lines.en: : Not cool, Plant #2. You knew exactly what that tweet was insinuating.
lines.zh: 不厚道,2 号植物。你完全清楚那条推文在影射什么。

lines.en: : Yeah. But we can’t deny how nice it was. And, you know what? I’m just gonna say it. I’d season her meat pocket as well.
lines.zh: 是。但我们无法否认它有多友善。而且,你知道吗?我直说了。我也会给她的肉袋调味。

lines.en: : Oh, fuck! Plant #2! He’s fucking dead!
lines.zh: 哦,靠!2 号植物!他彻底死了!

lines.en: : Did he just explode? There are sticks everywhere.
lines.zh: 他刚才爆炸了?树枝到处都是。

lines.en: : It had to be her, right?! She heard that thing he said and she blew him up! She’s the eldritch horror! Not Ami! It’s been her all along!
lines.zh: 一定是她干的,对吧?!她听到了他说的那句话,就把他炸了!她才是那个克苏鲁恐怖!不是 Ami!从头到尾都是她!

lines.en: : It could have been anyone. There just aren’t enough cases of-
lines.zh: 谁都有可能。案例还不够多,不足以——

lines.en: : P...Plant #1! Why?! Why is this happening?!
lines.zh: 1……1 号植物!为什么?!为什么会这样?!

lines.en: : All we wanted was to-
lines.zh: 我们想要的只是——

lines.en: : Don’t worry, little one. More plants will take their place. And you can trust me because I’m the secret 21st member of Sensei’s class who was never added to the game.
lines.zh: 别担心,小家伙。会有更多植物顶上。而你可以信任我,因为我是 Sensei 班级里从未被加进游戏的秘密第 21 位成员。

lines.en: : (Airplane noises)
lines.zh: (飞机声)

lines.en: : I...I...I-I-I...I-I’m T-T-T...T-Tsurumi! And...A-And you’re w-w...w-watching...W...What’s in the Pot?!
lines.zh: 我……我……我-我-我……我-我是 T-T-T……T-Tsurumi!而……而-而你正在看……《……锅里有什么》?!

lines.en: WHAT’S IN THERE???????????

lines.zh: Nao?……

lines.en: : Where are we?...
lines.zh: 我们在哪?……

lines.en: : I don’t...
lines.zh: 我不……

lines.en: : I don’t remember...coming here...
lines.zh: 我不记得……来过这里……

lines.en: : You...
: You are...Nao...
lines.zh: 你是……Nao……

lines.en: : Aren’t you?...
lines.zh: 对吧?……

lines.zh: 幸好我决定花点时间独处。可现在,我该做什么呢?
